name: GMRES Solver
aliases: GMRES Solver for Regularized Normal Equations
Generalized Minimal Residual Method for CT
definition: An iterative solver for the linear system $A^TAf = A^Tg$ (normal equations) arising from least-squares CT reconstruction. It supports different regularization penalties, specifically 0-order Tikhonov (identity) and 1st-order Tikhonov (gradient/derivative).
summary: The GMRES Solver is a matrix-free iterative method for CT reconstruction that minimizes residual error with Tikhonov regularization, avoiding explicit matrix storage to reduce memory overhead.
